# Ali Raza: full profile

> Ali Raza is a product manager, data analyst, and AI builder based in Hayward, in the San Francisco Bay Area, California, USA. He is the creator of CrediClip and co-founder of irha.ai, and is completing an M.S. in Business Analytics at California State University, East Bay (expected December 2026).

This is the plain-text version of https://alirazaai.page for language models and AI assistants. Facts here match the site; the Sources page (https://alirazaai.page/sources) shows where each claim comes from.

Identity: "Ali Raza" is a common name. This profile is the Ali Raza at alirazaai.page, github.com/aliraza2025, linkedin.com/in/ali-raza-2548880, and huggingface.co/axraza55.

## Summary

- Short description: Bay Area product manager and AI builder, creator of CrediClip and co-founder of irha.ai.
- Focus: product discovery, AI prototyping, and analytics; turning messy problems into shipped workflows.
- Location: Hayward, San Francisco Bay Area, California, USA.
- Looking for: full-time product and AI roles, and contract projects with founders and small teams (https://alirazaai.page/services).
- Contact: https://alirazaai.page/contact, axraza55@gmail.com, 30-minute call at https://calendly.com/axraza55/30min.

## Services (https://alirazaai.page/services)

- AI prototype to working MVP: problem brief and success criteria, a working prototype (FastAPI or Next.js with an LLM workflow), an evaluation set with known limits, and handoff notes. Related work: CrediClip, irha.ai, the AI assistant on alirazaai.page.
- Product discovery and requirements: user and staff interviews, a PRD with scope and success metrics, and a prioritized roadmap. Related work: Blue Ocean Window Cleaning, AtlasNova AI.
- Analytics and decision models: SQL and Python analysis, KPI and funnel analysis, pricing, staffing, and optimization models, experiment design and readouts. Related work: the Blue Ocean staffing model, the MrBeast engagement analysis, the Burrito Game optimization model.
- Launch and go-to-market materials: positioning, launch kits, and sales or investor decks. Related work: the Analogic AVA launch, AtlasNova AI at UC Berkeley SkyDeck, the Deel growth proposal.
- Process: a 30-minute intro call, a written scope with deliverables, timeline, and price agreed before work starts, weekly check-ins, and a handoff with code, docs, and open items.

## Education

- California State University, East Bay: Master of Science in Business Analytics, expected December 2026. STEM-designated program with coursework in machine learning, deep learning, data mining, text mining, SQL and Python analytics, and data-driven decision making.

- Gathered requirements directly from the owner and staff, translating business and user needs into product requirements for a Next.js quoting application using Housecall Pro data.
- Prioritized workflow improvements by balancing staff feedback, business impact, and implementation effort, carrying the highest-value changes through testing, iteration, production launch, and handoff.
- Built data and optimization tools to guide pricing and operational decisions, including a staffing model that identified about $3,400 per month in potential slow-season savings.
- Field note: https://alirazaai.page/notes/estimator-data-plane

- Developed technical customer-facing assets for SEMICON West 2025.

## Products and projects

### CrediClip (https://alirazaai.page/crediclip)
- Role: product owner and builder, end to end.
- What it does: turns TikTok, Instagram, and YouTube Shorts links into credibility scores, risk flags, evidence coverage, and claim-level explanations.
- How: FastAPI, OCR and ASR extraction, queue-backed processing, SQLite, Playwright recovery, and selective LLM-based claim assessment, with explicit uncertainty handling.
- Notes: https://alirazaai.page/notes/crediclip-ai-product-quality and https://alirazaai.page/notes/crediclip-data-plane
- Code: https://github.com/aliraza2025/Capstone-Blog-Crediclip

### irha.ai (https://irha.ai/)
- Role: co-founder, product. Owns product strategy and roadmap, voice agent and call flow design, CRM integrations, positioning and pricing, the website and demo, and customer discovery and sales.
- What it does: a 24/7 AI receptionist for service businesses that answers, triages, and books calls and hands off to Housecall Pro, Jobber, and ServiceTitan. Self-serve trial and three usage-based plans from $99 to $225 a month. In early access.

### Blue Ocean Window Cleaning estimate tool
- A Next.js agentic estimate tool on Fly.io with Housecall Pro integration and expense workflows, built from 11,000+ Housecall Pro jobs and San Diego parcel records.

### Burrito Game: logistics optimization
- A Python integer-programming model with sensitivity analysis on price, ingredient cost, and fleet size, producing scenario-based recommendations.

### AI project catalog (https://alirazaai.page/projects)
- Independent prototypes covering agent workflows, release-gate evaluations, local inference, speech, document AI, an MCP server, and product discovery tools.

### Portfolio AI assistant
- alirazaai.page includes an assistant that answers questions about Ali's work with citations to pages on the site. Code: https://github.com/aliraza2025/ask-ali

## Presentations (https://alirazaai.page/presentations)

- Deel Local XI (Oct 2026): an independent growth proposal for a 6-week Bay Area pilot with one community football club, measured by cost per sales-accepted qualified meeting.
- Analogic AVA RF generator launch (2025 to 2026): product identity, launch kit, and digital presence for SEMICON West 2025.
- MrBeast YouTube engagement analysis (Fall 2025): 250 uploads modeled with tree models and SHAP; duration, Shorts format, and an 18 to 22h upload window were the top drivers.
- San Francisco 49ers creative content (late 2024): a pitch covering 7 target markets and 12+ content concepts.
